language.desc: The single source of truth for languages: admin UI, public-site routes, dictionary labels and export headers all read this list.
language.hint: Restart the service after adding or removing a language or changing a path prefix — public-site routes are registered at startup.
language.savedRestart: Saved — restart the service for the public site to pick it up
language.prefixRoot: The default language serves the root path, so its prefix must be empty
language.prefixHint: Public-site path prefix, e.g. ja; leave empty to derive it from the language base tag
language.derivedHint: Derived from the language code when left empty
language.dateFormatHint: A Go layout string, e.g. 2006-01-02 or 2006年1月2日
